title: Czas przeszły · liczba mnoga
note: Completes the split made in a2_past_byc (James 2026-08-04): singular past there, plural past here, after plural-Nom. The -li/-ły choice is taught ONLY as a people-vs-everything-else test — at least one man or boy in the group takes -li, everything else takes -ły. The full virile system, virile adjectives and ci/ci sami are B1 and appear nowhere. No oni/one either: the pronouns encode the same distinction and would drag the virile system in early. Plural NOUN subjects are deliberately near-zero — the unit is about the verb — so groups of people are built from two singular nouns joined by i (mama i tata), and the only plural nouns used are klucze and książki, both already in the pool. i (and) is the one new lemma taught; without it a mixed group cannot be shown at all. Verbs: być (full six), mieszkać and robić (full six each, shown and tagged; the -ście forms are shown in a table and drilled only lightly, as the ty-forms were in a2_past_rest). IMPERFECTIVE ONLY — no aspect talk until a2_aspect. mieszkać glossed simple past (as in a2_past_ac), robić glossed progressive.

intro.title: We, you, they: the other half of the past
intro.body:
You already have the singular past: byłem, byłaś, był, była, było. Here is the rest of it.

The plural does not use -ł at all. It replaces that -ł with -li or -ły, and then adds the person ending:

· we → -śmy — the same -my you type on mieszkamy, robimy
· you (more than one person) → -ście — the same -cie as in mieszkacie, robicie
· they → nothing at all, exactly as the he-form had nothing

So być gives by- + li → byli, and byli + śmy → byliśmy.
intro.body_pl: Liczba mnoga: nie -ł, tylko -li / -ły. Potem -śmy (my), -ście (wy), a dla nich nic.

intro.title: -li or -ły? Ask one question
intro.body:
One new word first: i means and.

Now the whole choice, and it is a question about people, not about grammar labels:

Is there at least one man or boy in the group?
· Yes → -li
· No → -ły

-ły covers everything else — women and girls on their own, and every thing, animal and place. Polish treats two women and two keys the same way here. One man among nine women is still enough to make it -li.
intro.body_pl: Choć jeden mężczyzna w grupie → -li. Wszystko inne → -ły.

rows: Mama i tata byli w domu.
Mama i Anna były w domu.

intro.title: The same rule on every verb
intro.body:
Take the he-form you already know, drop the -ł, put -li or -ły in its place.

mieszkał → mieszka- → mieszkali / mieszkały
robił → robi- → robili / robiły

Then -śmy for we, or nothing at all for they. The -ł never survives into the plural — if you can still see it, the form is singular.
intro.body_pl: Forma on minus -ł, plus -li / -ły. Potem -śmy albo nic.

examples.en: Dad and my brother lived in the city.
examples.pl: Tata i brat mieszkali w mieście.

examples.en: Mum and my sister lived in the city.
examples.pl: Mama i siostra mieszkały w mieście.

examples.en: Mum and Dad were making breakfast.

intro.title: Talking to a group
intro.body:
-ście is the plural you — the one you use to a room rather than to one person. It is the -cie you already type on mieszkacie and robicie.

The order matters: choose -li or -ły first, then hang -ście on the end.

examples.en: Where were you yesterday? (to a group with a man)
What were you doing yesterday? (to a group with a man)

quiz.explain: There is a man in the group, so the verb takes -li. One man is enough — he does not have to be the majority.
No man in the group, so -ły. byłyśmy would mean we — the -śmy puts the speaker inside the group.
Things take -ły. było is the singular it — one key would be klucz był, but more than one moves to the plural.
Two men, so -li. The -ł of mieszkał is replaced, not kept: mieszka- + li.

quiz.prompt: Fix: Mama i tata były w domu. →
quiz.explain: były says there is no man in the group. tata is a man, so the verb has to move to byli.

quiz.prompt: Gdzie ___ wczoraj? (to a group with a man)
quiz.explain: -ście is the plural you. Make the -li / -ły choice first — the group has a man — then add -ście: byli + ście.

type_items.explain: The -ły- sits in front of the person ending, not after it. Choose -li or -ły first, then add -śmy.

type_items.prompt_en: we lived (a group with a man)
they lived (a group with a man)
type_items.explain: Nothing is added to mieszkał — the -ł itself is swapped out. Keeping it would give the singular back.
